findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, subject to payment of fees for Services properly performed through the effective termination date. Contractor may terminate only for Client's material breach under Section 12.1.
Invoices are payable Net 40. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.

Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, subject to payment of fees for Services properly performed through the effective termination date. Contractor may terminate only for Client's material breach under Section 12.1.
findings.explanation: Only the client can terminate the contract without cause, while you can only terminate for their breach. Because work done is paid, this is a low risk.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 20 days' written notice to the other party.

findings.quoted_text: Invoices are payable Net 40. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.
findings.explanation: Payment is due within 40 days of the invoice, which is longer than the standard 30 days and creates a cash flow delay.
findings.suggested_change: Invoices are payable Net 30 from the date of receipt of an undisputed invoice.
